given: a Reel draft with a primary video and Media-Studio flag on
then: the Montage panel is visible with track-presence rows (🎬 present requise)
test_id: MediaStudio.compose.test.tsx > flag on + reel → Montage panel present

given: the Montage panel in empty state with a primary video and mode=mock
then: a role='composed_video' mp4 is created with provider='compose:mock' costCents=0 (byte-copy) and a VideoPlayer appears
test_id: compose-draft-video.test.ts > mode=mock → byte-copy composed video no provider call

given: mode=mock or live
then: no HTTP request is made to any host (compose has no providers)
test_id: test-plan-msw.md no-network proof (request:start spy = [])

given: a draft with no primary video in the bundle
then: the request fails with 409 invalid_state Aucune vidéo primaire à monter before any ffmpeg call and no asset is written
test_id: compose-draft-video.test.ts > no primary video in bundle → throws HttpError invalid_state (409)

given: mode=live with only a primary video and no extra track
then: the request fails with 409 invalid_state Aucune piste à monter (voix-off musique ou sous-titres)
test_id: compose-draft-video.test.ts > mode=live + only primary video (no extra track) → throws invalid_state (409)

given: a draft with primary video + voice-over + subtitles in mock
then: the tracks report is {hasVoiceover:true hasMusic:false hasSubtitles:true} and the publish summary mirrors it
test_id: compose-draft-video.test.ts > mode=mock + voiceover + subtitles → tracks report

given: a draft already has a composed video (ready)
when: the operator changes a source track and clicks Recomposer
then: the existing role='composed_video' asset is replaced (upsert by role) and the player refreshes
test_id: compose-draft-video.test.ts > recompose replaces the existing composed_video asset (upsert by role)

given: a draft whose format is not Reel/Story
then: the service returns 409 invalid_state Montage réservé aux formats vidéo
test_id: compose-draft-video.test.ts > non-video draft → HttpError invalid_state

given: mode=live and ffmpeg emits an error during the mux
then: the service returns 502 upstream_failed Échec du montage ffmpeg the temp output is unlinked and no degraded asset is persisted
test_id: compose-draft-video.test.ts > ffmpeg error (live) → throws HttpError upstream_failed no asset persisted

given: mode=live and the source video file is missing on disk
then: the service returns 502 upstream_failed Fichier vidéo source introuvable with no writeFile
test_id: compose-draft-video.test.ts > source file missing → HttpError upstream_failed

given: mode=live and ffmpeg hangs past the timeout
then: the ffmpeg process is killed (SIGKILL) the temp output is cleaned and 502 Montage interrompu is returned
test_id: compose-media-bundle.test.ts > timeout => kills ffmpeg (SIGKILL) rejects compose_timeout unlinks output

given: an unknown key in the request body
then: it returns 400 invalid_input
test_id: compose.route.test.ts > 400 invalid_input on unknown key

given: an empty request body {}
then: it composes everything present with no export (defaults applied)
test_id: compose.route.test.ts > 200 { media } in mock mode (empty body)

given: export=true and the transcode fails (degraded)
then: the composed video still succeeds and the export field reports degraded=true
test_id: compose-draft-video.test.ts > export=true degraded transcode → composed succeeds export.degraded=true

given: a ready composed video on the draft
when: the operator opens the publish confirm dialog
then: the confirm previews the composed video (not the raw primary) with a track summary and publishing runs in dry-run
test_id: PublishActionGroup.compose.test.tsx > shows composed video in confirm when present

given: the Media-Studio feature flag is off
when: the operator opens step Visuel on a Reel draft
then: no Montage panel renders and the legacy MediaStudio behaves exactly as before
test_id: MediaStudio.compose.test.tsx > flag off → no Montage panel (DOM unchanged, non-regression)

given: the composeNode is refactored to use composeMediaBundle
when: the AI-Engine graph runs the compose node
then: the node returns the same graph channels (composition/currentStep/errors) and the existing node tests pass unchanged
test_id: compose.test.ts (existing 8 green unchanged)

given: no draft is selected (empty draftId)
then: a toast Sélectionnez d'abord une variante is shown and no request is sent
test_id: ComposePanel.test.tsx > guards empty draftId with a toast, no fetch

given: a primary video is missing in the panel
when: the operator views the Montage panel
then: the Composer button is disabled with a hint Générez d'abord une vidéo (blocked state)
test_id: ComposePanel.test.tsx > Composer disabled with hint when no primary video (blocked)

given: a draft with voice-over and music present in live mode
then: the ffmpeg mux ducks music to 0.3 and keeps voice-over at 1.0 via amix inputs=2 duration=longest
test_id: compose-media-bundle.test.ts > live + voiceover + music => amix inputs=2 duration=longest music ducked 0.3
